newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's June tax collection rate exceeds target.
newsitem.headline: Russia's June tax collection rate exceeds target.

text.p: The Russian government collected 25.8 trillion roubles ($4.46 billion) in tax revenue last month, 3.5 percent above the target level, a State Tax Service official said on Monday.

"The June tax volume is mainly due to RAO Gazprom's affiliates tax arrears payments," Information Department Head Ludmila Chepaikina said. But she said non-cash payments accounted for a significant part of the payments.
The state had collected 100 trillion roubles, or 85 percent of planned levels, in the first five months of the year, compared with 69 percent in the first quarter.
The government, desperate to raise cash to keep reforms on track, is pressing companies with heavy tax arrears, including Gazprom, the natural gas monopoly, to pay their debts.
Russia's tax shortfall is so steep that the government has proposed cutting the 1997 budget by 108 trillion roubles. But parliament has not approved the measure.
